select tfr.id as id, tfr.registration_no as registrationNo, tf.carrier_name as carrierName, tf.license_plate as licensePlate, tf.job_type as jobType, tf.card_no as smartCardID, sc.name as customerName, tfr.add_time as registrationTime
from task_flow_registration_item tfr left join task_flow tf on tfr.task_id = tf.id left join sts_customer sc on sc.id = tf.customer_id left join sts_smart_card ssc on ssc.id = tf.smart_card_id where DATE(tfr.add_time) = CURRENT_DATE order by tfr.add_time desc

select tfo.id as id, tfo.out_no as registrationNo, tf.carrier_name as carrierName, tf.license_plate as licensePlate, tf.job_type as jobType, tf.card_no as smartCardID, sc.name as customerName, tfo.add_time as registrationTime
from task_flow_out_item tfo left join task_flow tf on tfo.task_id = tf.id left join sts_customer sc on sc.id = tf.customer_id left join sts_smart_card ssc on ssc.id = tf.smart_card_id where DATE(tfo.add_time) = CURRENT_DATE
order by tfo.add_time desc
